title: Vertical Asymptote and p
text:
The vertical asymptote occurs where $x + p = 0$, i.e., at $x = -p$.

Given the vertical asymptote is at $x = -3$:
$$-p = -3$$
$$p = 3$$

title: Horizontal Asymptote and q
text:
The horizontal asymptote is at $y = q$.

Given the horizontal asymptote is at $y = 2$:
$$q = 2$$

title: State the Values
text: From the asymptotes:\n- $p = 3$ (from vertical asymptote $x = -3$)\n- $q = 2$ (from horizontal asymptote $y = 2$)
